Discover your exciting role

As Expert Functional Consulting - Engineer-to-Order (E2O) (m/f/d), you will drive the design and optimization of end-to-end Engineer-to-Order (E2O) processes across our global business landscape. Acting as a trusted partner between business stakeholders and technical teams, you will ensure that solutions are scalable, template-aligned, and fully integrated within the SAP S/4HANA ecosystem and connected applications.
In this role, you will lead the design of business-critical processes, support the integration of engineering and manufacturing environments, and enable the successful adoption of standardized solutions across multiple entities. Beyond technical consulting, you will contribute to business value creation by translating complex requirements into sustainable solutions, driving continuous improvement, and ensuring reliable service delivery in line with our global IT and business strategy.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Ensure stable and high-quality SAP S/4HANA operations for Engineering-to-Order process, aligned with SLAs and KPIs
- Lead end-to-end solution design across Engineering-to-Order process aligned with global template standards
- Drive fast onboarding and migration of acquired entities into SAP S/4HANA with minimal business disruption
- Govern external service providers and implementation partners, ensuring delivery quality and accountability
- Ensure integration, master data readiness, and testing quality for deployments and enhancements

Show your expertise

5+ years of SAP functional consulting experience with strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA Engineer-to-Order (E2O) and project manufacturing processes (PS, PP, MM, SD, CO)
Proven track record in SAP S/4HANA implementations, rollouts, or transformation projects
Strong understanding of engineering and manufacturing integrations, including tools such as SolidWorks, EPLAN, ETAP, or Inventor
Experience with SAP Fiori, workflow solutions, approval processes, and system integrations across SAP and connected applications
Degree in IT, Engineering, Business Informatics, or a related field, with SAP S/4HANA certification considered an advantage
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in international environments; fluent English required, German is a plus and willingness to travel for project deployments is expected
What we offer you

- Your start at Exyte: Take part in a two-day onboarding event with new colleagues
- Attractive location: Our location in Stuttgart features spacious workstations with height-adjustable desks
- Buddy-System: Several weeks of close familiarisation with your colleagues in the team
- Work-life balance: There is always the possibility of switching to mobile working
- Catering: Free coffee specialities as well as water dispensers are accessible on every floor
- Keep fit: Exyte subsidises your fitness contract through EGYM Wellpass at over 5,000 locations in Germany

Contact

You want to be part of the Exyte team? We look forward to receiving your application!
For further questions and information, please do not hesitate to contact Gerd Fleischmann via E-Mail at gerd.fleischmann@exyte.net.

Please note that we only consider applications submitted through our application portal. Applications sent via email will not be considered due to data protection regulations.

Nothing provides more motivation than success. Da Vinci Engineering is highly committed to ensuring the own employees' success. Become a part of us!

Senior Diagnostic Development Engineer (m/f/d)

Stellen-ID: 22202
Standort: München

We are searching intelligent and innovative employees. If you are interested in working for a dynamic company with flat hierarchy, we look forward to receiving your application.

Your tasks:

- Manage and track diagnostic activities using tools such as Jira, ensuring transparency of progress and task ownership
- Define diagnostic use cases aligned with vehicle system functions and validate their correct implementation
- Oversee integration and testing of OEM-specific diagnostic tools on test benches and vehicle systems
- Configure and maintain offboard diagnostic systems, including required hardware and infrastructure
- Implement and maintain diagnostic routines supporting production and aftersales environments
- Collaborate with homologation and legal teams to ensure compliance with standards such as UNECE R156 and DSSAD

- Completed university degree in Automotive, Electrical, or related field
- Experience with vehicle diagnostic systems, tools, and development processes
- Knowledge of diagnostic protocols such as UDS, DoCAN and DoIP
- Familiarity with homologation standards including UNECE R156, DSSAD and ZEVonUDS
- Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and work effectively in cross-functional teams
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a flexible and solution-oriented mindset
- Fluent in English (written and spoken). German is nice to have

You can expect ...

- Experience in exciting and international projects
- Continuous salary development
- Da Vinci Corporate Benefits

jobs.occupation: Senior Legal Counsel (m/w/d) Supply Chain, Procurement, Construction (Automobil-Fachwirt/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

Tesla is accelerating the world's transition to sustainable energy. We continuously develop revolutionary strategies and products within shortest time, and successfully launch them on a large scale. This is only possible through extraordinary speed, innovation, and efficiency. Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg forms the perfect basis for rolling out Tesla's incredible success story in Europe. The most important pillar for this is our employees. Their passion, motivation and engagement ensure that we consistently achieve our goals. We are looking for you to continue and expand this success story together. We are looking to hire a talented Senior Legal Counsel, Supply Chain, to join our legal team to support the Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg. In this role, you will support the purchasing manufacturing and engineering teams with supply chain matters in connection with the vehice production parts of the  manufactuting facility. The focus for this role is to be the trusted advisor for manufacturing, engineering, and procurement teams at the factory. You will be part of a global legal team that supports facilities and special projects throughout the world. 

What You’ll Do

- Support commercial and procurement teams on a variety of transactions and negotiations, including drafting and reviewing contracts in connection with sourcing for production parts (i.e., logistics, real estate, utility agreements and NDA’s). 
- Manage the enforcement of respective contracts (i.e., warranty claims, default notices, general claim management as well as dispute resolution)
- Provide strategic legal advice to manufacturing, engineering, and purchasing leads in supply chain insolvency matters
- Liaise with global Legal and Supply Chain teams to ensure global consistency
- Make an impact on organization and structures
- Report about and montior market developments in vehicle production parts supply chain matters 

What You’ll Bring

- At least 5 years’ relevant experience at a law firm and/or in-house corporate international environment, ideally with a commercial legal background, with an exceptional ability to handle a high workload of complex legal matters at the same time
- Team player with the ability to proactively identify problems, drive projects, and execute pragmatic/creative legal and business solutions on a timely basis
- Inspire trust, forge relationships quickly with key stakeholders at all levels, and earn the confidence and cooperation of your business partners
- Work well both autonomously, collaboratively and transparently, and are effective at juggling and prioritising competing tasks in a fast-paced, challenging environment
- Possess an entrepreneurial mindset, quick and flexible learner with high standards, impeccable integrity and ethics, unquestionable good judgment, and well-honed analytical skills
- Excellent communication skills, with a business level to near-native level fluency in German and English (written and spoken)
- Good sense of humour, disdain for drama, and a desire to get things doneWhat we offer You will be working in our state-of-the-art Gigafactory, where you’ll solve the world's most interesting problems with the best and brightest people who share a passion to change the world. Tesla’s compensation package includes competitive salary and Tesla shares or bonuses. Typical benefits that are offered are a pension programme, 30 vacation days, employee insurances, relocation and commuting support.

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

Privacy is a top priority for Tesla. We build it into our products and view it as an essential part of our business. To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Tesla Talent Privacy Notice.

Apply at: https://www.tesla.com/careers/search/job/282676?source=BA

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Manager, Indirect Procurement – Engineering Services, Supplies & Equipment (EMEA) (Automobil-Fachwirt/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

The Tesla EMEA Indirect Procurement team is looking for a highly motivated Supply Chain Manager to support procurement for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment across the broader EMEA region. You will partner closely with Engineering, Facilities, Finance, and operations stakeholders to source and manage complex service, supplies and equipment spend — from engineering consultancies, test and lab services, and specialized technical support through to engineering equipment, tooling, and infrastructure investments. This role requires a hands-on buyer who can drive end-to-end sourcing, negotiate commercial terms, ensure compliant purchase-to-pay execution, and keep critical engineering and capital programs on schedule and on budget.

What You’ll Do

- Serve as the primary Indirect Procurement partner for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment demand across EMEA, translating business requirements into clear scopes of work, sourcing strategies, and executable purchase packages.
- Lead end-to-end sourcing for engineering services (e.g., design/engineering support, testing, prototyping services, technical consultancy, and specialized lab/operations support) and engineering supplies (e.g., lab consumables, non-production hardware, development materials) and equipment categories (tooling, fixtures, facility and infrastructure investments).
- Own RFx processes (RFI/RFP/RFQ): develop bid packages, run competitive tenders, evaluate commercial and technical proposals, and present award recommendations that balance cost, lead time, quality, risk, and supplier capability.
- Dive deep into supplier quotes and statements of work to challenge scope, pricing structures, rates, milestones, and total cost of ownership; negotiate best cost, payment terms, warranties, SLAs, and commercial protections.
- Ensure supply activation and on-time delivery for engineering development activities and capital projects, proactively managing bottlenecks, change orders, and expedites.
- Partner with Engineering, Facilities, Finance/FP&A, Legal, and Compliance to align budgets, approval thresholds, contract terms, and capital equipment spend governance requirements.
- Manage the full purchase-to-pay lifecycle for assigned categories: requisition triage, PO creation/release, goods receipt / service confirmation support, invoice issue resolution, and spend compliance.
- Build and maintain a capable regional supplier base for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment across EMEA; drive preferred-supplier strategies, framework agreements, and multi-site leverage where beneficial.
- Track category spend, savings, cost avoidance, and risk; report status, escalations, and opportunities to Supply Chain leadership and key stakeholders.
- Work collaboratively at a cross-functional level with Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Supplier Industrialization, Legal, Finance, and other Supply Chain teams to deliver seamless operational support.
- Uphold Tesla procurement policies, ethical standards, and audit readiness across all sourcing and contracting activities.

What You’ll Bring

- You live and breathe procurement. You take ownership of assigned buying demand and ensure Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment needs stay in control from intake through delivery and payment.
- You possess a higher vocational or university qualification in a subject such as automotive engineering, mechanical engineering or business management, or equivalent experience
- Specific diploma’s Supply Chain/Purchasing are preferred
- Proven 5+ years of experience in Indirect Procurement, with hands-on ownership of Engineering Services and/or engineering equipment categories (equipment, tooling, technical services, project-related spend).
- Experience supporting manufacturing, automotive, industrial, or high-tech engineering environments is preferred; familiarity with plant/lab operations at a gigafactory or similar large industrial site is a plus.
- Strong commercial acumen: able to interpret complex SOWs, rate cards, and multi-year service proposals and negotiate cost, terms, and risk allocation.
- Comfortable operating across multiple sites and stakeholders across Tesla operations specifically in the wider EMEA region; experience with cross-border sourcing and multi-currency contracting is advantageous.
- Working knowledge of P2P / ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, or equivalent) and standard procurement governance (DOA, capital expenditure approval flows, contract lifecycle).
- Analytical, structured, and hands-on — equally effective running a strategic tender and resolving day-to-day PO, delivery, or invoice issues.
- Exceptional stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills; ability to lead high-stakes contract discussions, challenge constructively and drive decisions at pace.
- You are fluent in English; German language skills are a strong plus.

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

A Snapshot of Your Day

The S4 program at Siemens Energy, formally called S4E or S4E‑Unify, is one of the major global Business- & IT Transformation Programs within Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions. The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.  The S4E program is delivered through phased “Unify” rollout waves, bringing sites and business areas live step by step on SAP S/4HANA. It includes standardized business templates, a defined operating model with strong governance and board‑level sponsorship, and an enhanced user experience that modernizes how employees work.
